subject: Actual percent methylation of two groups

messages.author: d22662a8412e76f2
messages.subject: Actual percent methylation of two groups
parts:
Hello.

is it possible within methylKit to not only see percent methylation difference, but the actual percent methylation of the two groups that the difference was calculated from? For example, if the meth.diff is 30%, could methylKit tell me if the percent methylation values of the two groups were 90% and 60% or 40% and 10% and so on.

Thanks for the help,
Katarina

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Actual percent methylation of two groups
parts:
if you use pool() then percMethylation() you should get values that will create  identical or close to the differences you observe from calculateDiffMeth()

Best,
Altuna
